items.prompt: A classic black-and-white football with plain unmarked panels on the centre spot of an empty pitch at blue hour, shot low, the background dissolved into soft bokeh with a hint of yellow and navy blue color. Color editorial sports photograph, full-frame camera, 35mm lens at f/2, natural light, shallow depth of field, realistic colors, fine detail, subtle film grain, calm atmospheric mood.
